sql: SELECT d.primary_name AS director_name, a.primary_name AS actor_name, COUNT(*) AS collaboration_count, ROUND(AVG(t.average_rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM principals pd JOIN titles t ON pd.title_id = t.id AND t.title_type = 'movie' JOIN principals pa ON pa.title_id = t.id AND pa.category_id IN ('actor', 'actress') JOIN names d ON pd.name_id = d.id JOIN names a ON pa.name_id = a.id WHERE pd.category_id = 'director' AND t.average_rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.id, d.primary_name, a.id, a.primary_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 AND AVG(t.average_rating) >= 7.5 ORDER BY collaboration_count DESC, avg_rating DESC

issues.message: SQL 无 LIMIT 子句。但这是聚合查询(GROUP BY)，且按任务规范要求通过 run_sql 的 limit 参数控制返回行数，不在 SQL 中写 LIMIT。
issues.suggestion: 通过 run_sql(sql, limit=N) 控制返回行数
